# `aitbc node list`

List all configured nodes and their connection settings.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node list
```
